title: vectorize_x4 for MEM_BW_BOUND
rationale_md:
The kernel issues one 4-byte load and one 4-byte store per element, so the request
count (not the byte count) is the limit: 32-byte sectors are half-used. Loading and
storing `int4` lets one instruction move 16 bytes, cutting the number of memory
instructions and sectors by 4x. The measured SOL is below the roofline because the
request rate, not the byte rate, is saturated.
refs: NVIDIA CUDA C++ Programming Guide: vector types
expected_effect: 4x fewer memory requests, up to 4x effective bandwidth
